第54章 怡红院-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

念念就停留在远处，看着两人斗法，她现在有鬼柳环附身，吴姜倒是不担心她的安危。

两人瞬间缠斗在一起，阴气碰撞的声音在寂静的山间回荡。

这女鬼的实力，果然比那个色鬼强得多，身手灵活，阴气也更加浓郁，吴姜一时之间竟难以取胜。

缠斗了足足十几分钟，吴姜渐渐摸清了女鬼的套路，趁着女鬼攻击的间隙，一记幽影刺悄无声息的发出，趁着女鬼发出闷哼的时候，又是一记镇魂定身印，打在了女鬼的身上。

这下，女鬼终于不能动弹了。

吴姜喘了口气，祭出勾魂索，将女鬼牢牢绑住，任凭女鬼再大的本事，也休想挣脱了。

他可不会让这女鬼魂飞魄散，把她押送回地府，交给地府判官审判，十八层地狱，才是她最好的归宿。

吴姜回到念念的身边，小丫头正满脸崇拜的看着他。

“哥哥，你还厉害呀！”

吴姜非常享受小丫头的目光，得意的说道：“所以，念念以后胆子可要大一些哦，哥哥会保护好你的。”

看到念念又是“嗯嗯”了两声，他这才将念念收回聚灵吊坠，提着被绑住的女鬼，身形一闪，踏入了阴阳通道之中。

朱宏正坐在桌前喝茶，看到吴姜又押着一个厉鬼进来，脸上露出几分惊讶，又感到颇为稀奇，阳间现在的厉鬼这么多了吗？

两人先是寒暄了几句，但还是正事要紧，开始和吴姜做起交接。

吴姜见事情办完了，正准备跟朱宏告辞，却被朱宏一把拦住：“哎，老弟，别急着走啊！上次说好了，哥哥请你喝一杯的，择日不如撞日，就今天了，你可不许推辞啊！”

吴姜刚想推辞，听到朱宏的话，就没有再开口，便点了点头，答应了下来。

朱宏随即叫来一个小鬼差，替他坐班，然后带着吴姜，朝着酆都城的方向走去。

酆都城是地府最繁华的地方，街道两旁灯火通明，来往的都是各种各样的鬼魂和阴差，鬼声鼎沸，热闹非常。

吴姜欣赏着酆都城的风景，走了约莫半个时辰，终于来到一间颇为气派的酒楼面前。

Nian Nian stayed in the distance, watching the fight between the two. She was now possessed by the ghost Liu Huan, but Wu Jiang was not worried about her safety.

The two of them fought together instantly, and the sound of the collision of Yin Qi echoed in the silent mountains.

The strength of this female ghost was indeed much stronger than that of the perverted ghost. Her agility and yin energy were much stronger. It was difficult for Wu Jiang to win for a while.

After fighting for more than ten minutes, Wu Jiang gradually figured out the tricks of the female ghost. Taking advantage of the gap between the female ghost's attacks, he quietly sent out a shadow stab. When the female ghost made a muffled groan, he hit the female ghost with a soul-soothing seal.

At this time, the female ghost finally couldn't move.

Wu Jiang took a breath and used the hook to tie the female ghost tightly. No matter how powerful the female ghost was, she would never be able to break free.

He would not let this female ghost fly away. He would escort her back to the underworld and hand her over to the underworld judge for trial. The eighteenth level of hell was her best destination.

Wu Jiang returned to Niannian, and the little girl was looking at him with admiration.

"Brother, you are so awesome!"

Wu Jiang enjoyed the little girl's gaze very much and said proudly: "So, Niannian, you must be more courageous in the future. Brother will protect you."

Seeing Nian Nian say "hmm" twice again, he took Nian Nian back into the spirit-gathering pendant, carried the tied female ghost, and stepped into the Yin-Yang passage in a flash.

Zhu Hong was sitting at the table drinking tea. When he saw Wu Jiang escorting another evil ghost in, his face showed a bit of surprise, and he felt quite strange. Are there so many evil ghosts in the world now?

The two exchanged pleasantries for a while, but then they got down to business and began to hand over to Wu Jiang.

Seeing that the matter was done, Wu Jiang was about to say goodbye to Zhu Hong, but he was stopped by Zhu Hong: "Hey, brother, don't leave in a hurry! As we agreed last time, my brother invited you to have a drink. It's better to choose a different day. It's today. You can't refuse!"

Wu Jiang just wanted to refuse, but after hearing Zhu Hong's words, he didn't speak again, so he nodded and agreed.

Zhu Hong immediately called a little ghost to take over the duty for him, and then took Wu Jiang towards the direction of Fengdu City.

Fengdu City is the most prosperous place in the underworld. The streets are brightly lit on both sides, and there are all kinds of ghosts and ghosts coming and going. There is a lot of ghost noise and it is very lively.

Wu Jiang admired the scenery of Fengdu City, walked for about half an hour, and finally came to a rather impressive restaurant.
